title: Appliance Rebates in Kitchener 2026: Up to $200 Per Appliance
desc: Kitchener appliance rebates for 2026: $25 to $200 from Home Renovation Savings, with Enova Power as distributor.
lead: Kitchener has 99,815 households and 40% rent. The appliance rebates need a replacement of an existing electric appliance.
cards_heading: What Ontario pays for new appliances in Kitchener
cards_intro: We re-read the program's appliance page on October 4, 2026. The rebates are province-wide, so the amounts are the same in every city, and the rules about what you replace and which model you buy are what decide a claim.

cards.title: Heat pump clothes dryer
cards.note: The largest of the six appliance rebates, for a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient heat pump dryer replacing an electric dryer.

cards.title: Induction cooktop or range
cards.note: For a new induction cooktop or range on the program's product list, replacing an existing electric one.

cards.title: Washing machine
cards.note: For a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient washer on the program list.

cards.title: Fridge
cards.note: For a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient refrigerator replacing an existing electric one.

cards.title: Freezer
cards.note: For a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient freezer on the list.

cards.title: Dishwasher
cards.note: For a new ENERGY STAR Most Efficient dishwasher on the list.

cards.title: Who can claim
cards.note: A residential customer on the Ontario grid with an existing electric appliance in need of replacing. Cornwall Electric customers are excluded.

cards.title: Free route
cards.note: Income-qualified households can get energy-efficient fridges and freezers at no charge, along with other upgrades.

after_cards: The appliance page states no end date, so confirm it is still open before you buy.
sections: Rebates and a mixed housing stock

47% of Kitchener households live in detached houses and 15% in buildings of five or more storeys. The appliance page names no home type, so the same rules apply across the mix. The common reasons for a refusal are a model that is not on the list and a purchase more than 60 days old.
Enova Power distributes power and Kitchener postal codes begin with N, which the Energy Affordability Program lists. Our lookup shows Enova Power as the distributor, so check your own bill.

The program page asks for an existing electric appliance in need of replacing. A new fridge to go in a spare corner, or an induction range where the kitchen had no range, is not a replacement. If you are switching from gas to an electric appliance, the page does not say whether that counts, so ask the program before you buy. Kitchener households that already cook on an electric range are the clearest fit for the induction rebate.
Most Efficient, not just ENERGY STAR

The rebate is for ENERGY STAR Most Efficient models, which the page describes as going beyond standard ENERGY STAR requirements. A fridge with the ordinary ENERGY STAR mark may not qualify. Each appliance has its own product list linked from the program page, so find the model number there before you pay, whether you buy in Kitchener or online.

The page states no limit per household and no end date. That does not mean unlimited funding, and the program can change. If you plan to replace a washer and a dryer, or a fridge and a freezer, get them on the program's lists first and keep every receipt, since each claim is separate and has its own 60-day window.

Unlike the thermostat rebate, the appliance page lists no home type. It asks for a residential customer on the Ontario grid. It does not address condos or apartments directly, so a Kitchener condo owner or tenant should confirm with the program. 40% of Kitchener households rent, and a tenant should ask the landlord before swapping a fridge or range that came with the unit.
claim_steps: Check that the appliance you are replacing is electric and that you are on the Ontario grid.
Find a new model on the program's ENERGY STAR Most Efficient list for that appliance.
Buy it new from any retailer and keep the receipt.
Upload the receipt on the program page within 60 days of purchase.
If your household income is under the limits, call 1-844-770-3148 about free fridges and freezers first.
faq: Does Enova Power give an appliance rebate?
The page does not address condos. Ask.
Can I claim a freezer and a fridge?
The page states none. Confirm before buying.
